Texture will wrap a tapered 3D trunk, so vertical grain and natural scale should remain consistent across the entire image. Full bleed, perfectly seamless opposite left/right edges and top/bottom edges. Flat shadow-free diffuse lighting suitable as game albedo; no baked sun direction, no glossy highlights, no ambient cast shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no tree photograph showing cylindrical silhouette, no visible object borders. No planks, sawn wood fibres, dominant knots, labels, text, watermark, material sphere, atlas, or collage. Deliver only the square texture.
